project_title: PAUSE App - Category Cards & 3D Icons Implementation Blueprint
scope: Concise implementation blueprint for updating existing PAUSE category cards and 3D icons style according to reference attachment.

blueprint_summary.objective: Redesign existing 12 category tiles plus 'Qualsiasi' (All) card to match reference 3D icon style with dark rounded tiles and colored bottom glow light.
blueprint_summary.key_behavior: Bottom colored light activates when tile is selected. Selecting 'Qualsiasi' (All) activates bottom lights across all category cards simultaneously.

category_entities.name: Arte
category_entities.icon_3d: 3D artist palette with liquid paint drops

bottom_light_effect.active_rule: Glow container at tile bottom with radial/linear gradient in category color
bottom_light_effect.glow_selected: Opacity 1, boxShadow or gradient reflection at bottom edge
bottom_light_effect.qualsiasi_rule: When 'all' is in selected Set, all category tiles trigger glow_selected state

instructions_to_main_agent: Do NOT add new category entities. Stick strictly to the 12 existing categories plus 'all'.
Update CategoryGrid in /app/frontend/src/components/category-grid.js to check if selected.has('all') when rendering individual tile lights.
Preserve story and lesson dynamic count display logic in countFor(category).
Maintain full dark rounded tile layout with 3 columns, adhering to theme tokens.
Ensure all interactive Pressable and Text elements retain data-testid attributes.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: Avoid generic centered layouts or plain gradients without depth.
Use glass-morphism effects and soft translucent borders for interactive elements.
Always provide micro-interactions for hover/pressed states.
Maintain high APCA text contrast ratios for readability against dark surfaces.
Ensure data-testid attributes are preserved on all interactive elements.
